content:
Thousands of Catholic faithful gathered in Nuevo Laredo this week for the patronal festivities of San Judas Tadeo, the saint of difficult causes, at the parish in the Fovissste neighborhood, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo. Devotees came to pray, give thanks for favors received and ask for the saint's intercession.

The celebration filled the parish grounds with mariachi, dancers and musical trios, El Mañana reported. Inside the church, the danza de San Agustín performed a tribute dance, while outside, vendors sold Mexican snacks including tamales, menudo, pozole, gorditas, enchiladas and churros.

Monseñor Carlos Lerma Martínez, bishop of the Diocese of Nuevo Laredo, officiated the Mass, offering a message of peace and prosperity for the city, according to El Mañana. The festivities closed with musical performances by La Cúspide and La Misión Colombiana.

Among the faithful was Blanca, 52, who walked on her knees from the entrance of the Iglesia de San Judas Tadeo to the atrium in gratitude, El Mañana reported — one of many personal acts of devotion that marked a celebration the paper described as a devotion without limits.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "San Judas Tadeo: dolor, fe y esperanza; una devoción sin límites," October 29, 2026
